 "data": "---
config:
 theme: base
 themeVariables:
 fontFamily: Inter, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
 actorBkg: \"#e7f5ff\"
 actorBorder: \"#1c7ed6\"
 actorTextColor: \"#212529\"
 actorLineColor: \"#adb5bd\"
 signalColor: \"#495057\"
 signalTextColor: \"#212529\"
 noteBkgColor: \"#fff9db\"
 noteBorderColor: \"#b59f00\"
 noteTextColor: \"#212529\"
 labelBoxBkgColor: \"#f1f3f5\"
 labelBoxBorderColor: \"#868e96\"
 loopTextColor: \"#212529\"
 sequenceNumberColor: \"#ffffff\"
---
sequenceDiagram
 autonumber
 actor U as 👤 Usuário
 box rgb(231,245,255) Serviço
 participant A as 🖥️ video-api (via gateway)
 end
 box rgb(235,251,238) Dados gerenciados
 participant D as 🐘 PostgreSQL
 participant S as 🪣 S3
 end
 box rgb(255,244,230) Mensageria
 participant Q as 📨 SQS
 end
 box rgb(231,245,255) Processamento
 participant W as ⚙️ video-worker
 end
 U->>A: POST /videos
 A->>D: Transação curta: reservar limpeza do objeto
 A->>S: Enviar original fora da transação
 A->>D: Transação: cancelar limpeza + vídeo QUEUED + outbox
 A-->>U: 201 + id + QUEUED
 A-)Q: Publisher envia evento e confirma outbox
 Q-)W: VideoUploadRequested
 W->>S: Adquirir lease do vídeo
 W-)Q: PROCESSING_STARTED
 Q-)A: Atualizar status
 W->>S: Verificar ZIP existente ou baixar original
 W->>W: Extrair frames e compactar
 W->>S: Persistir ZIP
 W-)Q: PROCESSING_COMPLETED
 W->>Q: Excluir mensagem processada
 Q-)A: Aplicar resultado no banco
 U->>A: GET /videos e GET /videos/{id}/download
 A->>S: Ler ZIP privado
 A-->>U: Streaming do ZIP",

 "data": "---
config:
 theme: base
 themeVariables:
 fontFamily: Inter, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
 actorBkg: \"#e7f5ff\"
 actorBorder: \"#1c7ed6\"
 actorTextColor: \"#212529\"
 actorLineColor: \"#adb5bd\"
 signalColor: \"#495057\"
 signalTextColor: \"#212529\"
 noteBkgColor: \"#fff9db\"
 noteBorderColor: \"#b59f00\"
 noteTextColor: \"#212529\"
 labelBoxBkgColor: \"#f1f3f5\"
 labelBoxBorderColor: \"#868e96\"
 loopTextColor: \"#212529\"
 sequenceNumberColor: \"#ffffff\"
---
sequenceDiagram
 autonumber
 box rgb(231,245,255) Processamento
 participant W as ⚙️ video-worker
 end
 box rgb(255,244,230) Mensageria
 participant Q as 📨 SQS
 end
 box rgb(231,245,255) Serviços
 participant A as 🖥️ video-api
 participant N as ✉️ notification-worker
 end
 box rgb(255,240,246) Externos
 participant M as 📧 SMTP (e-mail)
 participant O as 🚨 Webhook de operação
 end
 W->>W: ffprobe recusa o arquivo
 W-)Q: PROCESSING_FAILED + motivo
 Q-)A: Aplicar FAILED
 A->>A: Mesma transação: FAILED + NotificationRequested na outbox
 A-)Q: Publicar pedido de notificação
 Q-)N: NotificationRequested
 N->>N: Reivindicar envio (vídeo, EMAIL)
 N->>M: Enviar e-mail ao usuário
 alt E-mail entregue ao servidor SMTP
 N->>Q: Excluir mensagem
 else E-mail falhou
 N->>O: Alertar a operação (uma vez, sem e-mail do usuário)
 N--)Q: Não excluir: SQS reentrega e o e-mail é tentado de novo
 Note over Q,N: Após 3 recebimentos, a mensagem vai para a DLQ
 end",
 "config": null

 edgeLabelBackground: \"#ffffff\"
---
flowchart TB
 INT[\"👤 Internet\"] --> NLB[\"🌐 Network Load Balancer<br/>TLS autoassinado · cert-manager\"]
 subgraph AWS[\"☁️ AWS Academy Learner Lab · us-east-1\"]
 subgraph VPC[\"VPC · 2 AZs · sem NAT\"]
 subgraph EKS[\"☸️ EKS · 2 nós t3.large · role LabRole\"]
 ING[\"🌐 ingress-nginx\"]
 subgraph APP[\"namespace fiapx\"]
 GWP[\"🚪 video-gateway\"]
 APIP[\"🖥️ video-api (HPA)\"]
 WKP[\"⚙️ video-worker (KEDA)\"]
 NTP[\"✉️ notification-worker\"]
 WEBP[\"🖼️ web\"]
 end
 subgraph MON[\"📊 namespace monitoring\"]
 PROM[\"Prometheus\"]
 LOKI[\"Loki + Alloy\"]
 GRAF[\"Grafana\"]
 end
 KEDA[\"📏 KEDA\"]
 end
 RDS[(\"🐘 RDS PostgreSQL 17\")]
 REDIS[(\"⚡ ElastiCache Redis 7.1\")]
 end
 SQS[[\"📨 SQS · 3 filas + 3 DLQs\"]]
 S3[(\"🪣 S3 · 2 buckets privados\")]
 SSM[\"🔑 SSM Parameter Store\"]
 ECR[\"📦 ECR · 5 imagens\"]
 CW[\"📈 CloudWatch\"]
 end
 NLB --> ING
 ING --> GWP
 ING --> WEBP
 GWP --> APIP
 GWP --> REDIS
 APIP --> REDIS
 APIP --> RDS
 APIP --> S3
 APIP -.-> SQS
 WKP -.-> SQS
 WKP --> S3
 NTP -.-> SQS
 NTP --> RDS
 KEDA -.->|profundidade| SQS
 GRAF -.-|métricas AWS| CW
 SSM -->|segredos no deploy| APP
 ECR -->|imagens| APP

 classDef actor fill:#fff9db,stroke:#b59f00,color:#212529
 classDef edge fill:#f1f3f5,stroke:#868e96,color:#212529
 classDef svc fill:#e7f5ff,stroke:#1c7ed6,color:#212529
 classDef queue fill:#fff4e6,stroke:#d9480f,color:#212529
 classDef data fill:#ebfbee,stroke:#2b8a3e,color:#212529
 classDef ext fill:#fff0f6,stroke:#c2255c,color:#212529
 classDef obs fill:#f3f0ff,stroke:#6741d9,color:#212529
 classDef bad fill:#fff5f5,stroke:#c92a2a,color:#212529
 classDef note fill:#ffffff,stroke:#adb5bd,stroke-dasharray:4 3,color:#495057
 class INT actor
 class NLB,ING,GWP,KEDA edge
 class APIP,WKP,NTP,WEBP svc
 class PROM,LOKI,GRAF,CW obs
 class RDS,REDIS,S3 data
 class SQS queue
 class SSM,ECR note
 style AWS fill:#ffffff,stroke:#adb5bd,stroke-dasharray:4 3,color:#495057
 style VPC fill:#ffffff,stroke:#adb5bd,stroke-dasharray:4 3,color:#495057
 style EKS fill:#f8f9fa,stroke:#868e96,color:#495057
 style APP fill:#f8fbff,stroke:#1c7ed6,color:#1c7ed6
 style MON fill:#f3f0ff,stroke:#6741d9,stroke-dasharray:5 3,color:#6741d9
 linkStyle 9,10,12,14 stroke:#d9480f,stroke-width:1.6px,stroke-dasharray:6 4
 linkStyle 15 stroke:#6741d9,stroke-width:1.4px,stroke-dasharray:4 4",
 "config": null

---
flowchart TB
 subgraph FONTES[\"Fontes\"]
 SVC[\"🖥️ 4 serviços Spring<br/>/actuator/prometheus\"]
 KSM[\"☸️ kube-state-metrics<br/>node-exporter\"]
 EDGE[\"🌐 ingress-nginx · KEDA\"]
 LOGS[\"📜 stdout JSON dos pods<br/>com correlationId\"]
 AWSM[\"☁️ RDS · SQS · ElastiCache<br/>S3 · NLB\"]
 end
 subgraph MON[\"📊 namespace monitoring\"]
 PROM[\"Prometheus<br/>2 dias\"]
 ALLOY[\"Alloy\"]
 LOKI[\"Loki<br/>72 h\"]
 GRAF[\"Grafana<br/>8 dashboards\"]
 AM[\"Alertmanager<br/>9 alertas próprios + padrão\"]
 end
 SVC -.- PROM
 KSM -.- PROM
 EDGE -.- PROM
 LOGS -.- ALLOY
 ALLOY --> LOKI
 AWSM -.- CW[\"📈 CloudWatch\"]
 PROM --> GRAF
 PROM --> AM
 LOKI --> GRAF
 CW --> GRAF
 AM -->|SMTP da aplicação| MAILA[\"📧 E-mail +alertas\"]
 AM -->|HTTP| HOOK[\"🚨 Webhook de alertas\"]

 "data": "---
config:
 theme: base
 themeVariables:
 fontFamily: Inter, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
 actorBkg: \"#e7f5ff\"
 actorBorder: \"#1c7ed6\"
 actorTextColor: \"#212529\"
 actorLineColor: \"#adb5bd\"
 signalColor: \"#495057\"
 signalTextColor: \"#212529\"
 noteBkgColor: \"#fff9db\"
 noteBorderColor: \"#b59f00\"
 noteTextColor: \"#212529\"
 labelBoxBkgColor: \"#f1f3f5\"
 labelBoxBorderColor: \"#868e96\"
 loopTextColor: \"#212529\"
 sequenceNumberColor: \"#ffffff\"
---
sequenceDiagram
 autonumber
 box rgb(255,244,230) Mensageria
 participant Q as 📨 SQS (visibilidade padrão 960 s)
 end
 box rgb(231,245,255) video-worker
 participant C as 🔁 SqsQueueConsumer
 participant H as 🎞️ Handler (ffmpeg)
 end
 box rgb(241,243,245) Plataforma
 participant K as ☸️ Kubernetes
 end
 C->>Q: ReceiveMessage (long polling 20 s, 1 mensagem)
 Q-->>C: mensagem
 C->>Q: heartbeat imediato: visibilidade = 120 s
 C->>H: processar
 loop a cada 30 s enquanto processa
 C->>Q: renovar visibilidade (120 s)
 end
 K--)C: SIGTERM (scale-down ou deploy)
 Note over C: para de buscar mensagens,<br/>mas não interrompe o handler
 H-->>C: concluído
 C->>Q: DeleteMessage
 C--)K: encerra (prazo até 960 s · grace do pod 1.020 s)",
 "config": null
